protocol.note: fold construction + Ridge solver identical to wf380a2_ridge_r2_cv, so the 32-d control here reproduces the on-disk +0.01025

feature_composition.added_18d: PCA(18) of Morgan ECFP4 (radius=2, 2048-bit), fit inside each training fold
feature_composition.why_not_chemprop_v3: no trained chemprop v3 encoder checkpoint exists on disk (chemprop_v3_encoder_forward builds an untrained ChempropV2Encoder; 'frozen' in blk_d2 reports means weights frozen, not pretrained) — an 18-d slice of a random encoder would be noise, so it is not used
feature_composition.why_not_hilbert: no SMILES -> Hilbert-coordinate featurizer exists in the repo; the '50-d' tier label names a family, not a defined composition

verdict.reading: 50-d (32-d RDKit + 18 PCA dims of a real Morgan fingerprint) does not move platinai_4cell R^2 off zero: the cohort is representation-limited, not feature-count-limited. metalcytotox_combined stays the load-bearing cohort.

honest_negative.still_open_in_blocker: the blocker's Step 2 (chemprop_v3 frozen encoder) is not achievable — no trained encoder exists on disk; Step 3 (Hilbert 18-d) has no defined featurizer. Both are recorded here rather than papered over with a random-encoder feature.
honest_negative.do_not_over_claim: platinai_4cell is a Pt-only continuous-regression cohort; it is not the MetalCytoToxDB 5-metal classification task and BLK-C15 does not transfer.
